rules: Recommendations illustrate the decision and workflow shape; they are not FanDuel account findings.
Platform-action candidates remain previews until live connectors, fresh reads and human approval are available.
Strategic recommendations route into Planning OS and cannot silently overwrite the active plan.
Country and product alerts require governance review before any proposed platform change.

recommendations.title: Move budget from conquest to higher-intent search
recommendations.summary: Rebalance a bounded share from the conquest campaign into brand defence and product-intent campaigns.
recommendations.rationale: The synthetic Google Ads rows show conquest as the weakest CPA shape while brand and product terms carry stronger response signals.
recommendations.planning_prompt: Review the next monthly Paid Search allocation. Protect brand coverage and move a bounded share from conquest into product-intent campaigns, while preserving the working-media envelope and showing the before/after campaign logic.

recommendations.title: Refresh responsive search ad creative
recommendations.summary: Create a new RSA variant for product-intent ad groups and hold the current winner as the control.
recommendations.rationale: A controlled creative refresh is a reversible way to improve message fit without changing the keyword or budget structure.

recommendations.title: Add negative keywords to broad conquest traffic
recommendations.summary: Block irrelevant employment, support and non-US informational queries from the broad conquest set.
recommendations.rationale: The action is narrow, reversible and can be reviewed at keyword level before it reaches Google Ads.

proposed_action.current: No shared exclusion set in the demo record
proposed_action.proposed: Add reviewed negatives: jobs, customer service, Canada

recommendations.title: Route product-intent ads to the matching landing page
recommendations.summary: Change the final URL for the Sportsbook product ad from a generic hub to the relevant state-aware product page.
recommendations.rationale: The destination should match product intent, but the state/product availability check must pass first.

recommendations.title: Create a dedicated comparison landing page
recommendations.summary: Brief a compliant comparison page for high-intent competitor and alternative queries.
recommendations.rationale: A new page is a content and compliance workflow, not a direct ad-platform setting change.

recommendations.title: Country targeting extends beyond the US plan
recommendations.summary: The demonstration change set shows Canada included on a US campaign.
recommendations.rationale: Country scope is a hard control. Remove out-of-scope targeting only after a fresh campaign read confirms the setting.

recommendations.title: Campaign budget is above its declared cap
recommendations.summary: The demonstration setting is 18% above the campaign cap recorded in the approved working-media plan.
recommendations.rationale: Budget edits are high-impact and require a current platform value, plan receipt and explicit approval.

recommendations.title: Refresh fatigued Meta creative
recommendations.summary: Introduce two new short-form variants and retain the current ad as a holdout control.
recommendations.rationale: Creative rotation is the clearest next test when delivery remains available but response is softening.

proposed_action.proposed: Retain control and add two approved variants

recommendations.title: Rebalance Meta prospecting and retargeting
recommendations.summary: Move a bounded share from the weaker prospecting ad set into the stronger retargeting set without changing the channel envelope.
recommendations.rationale: The recommendation preserves the approved Paid Social working-media total and makes the ad-set trade-off visible.
recommendations.planning_prompt: Review next month's Paid Social plan. Preserve the Paid Social working-media envelope and show a bounded reallocation from weaker prospecting into stronger retargeting, including the holdout and creative implications.

recommendations.title: Meta ad set includes an out-of-scope country
recommendations.summary: The demonstration ad set includes Canada alongside the approved US scope.
recommendations.rationale: Geo correction is logical to action in-platform after a fresh read and state/product governance check.

recommendations.title: Meta ad-set budget does not match the approved split
recommendations.summary: The demonstration daily-budget ratio differs from the signed-off prospecting/retargeting split.
recommendations.rationale: The proposed correction needs a current ad-set read and a check for campaign-budget optimisation before any write.

recommendations.title: Cut a short-form YouTube refresh for the next peak window
recommendations.summary: Create six- and fifteen-second variants mapped to the next modelled sports-demand window.
recommendations.rationale: The calendar can set the testing window, but creative claims remain authored-working until delivery data replaces the synthetic source.

recommendations.title: Add a geo-holdout to the next CTV flight
recommendations.summary: Design a measured holdout before scaling the next premium sports window.
recommendations.rationale: CTV delivery is modelled and needs incrementality evidence before it should drive a larger allocation.
recommendations.planning_prompt: Create a CTV measurement recommendation for the next premium sports window. Keep the current working-media plan intact, specify a geo holdout, decision threshold and evidence needed before scale.

recommendations.title: Match display retargeting to product-specific pages
recommendations.summary: Split the generic destination by approved product and state rather than sending all users to one hub.
recommendations.rationale: The change requires product/state governance and tracking validation before trafficking.

recommendations.title: Create state-aware evergreen landing pages
recommendations.summary: Build an approved template that separates live product information from watch-state education.
recommendations.rationale: Organic Search is a zero-spend demand line; the recommendation is a content workflow, not a media-budget move.

recommendations.title: Separate new-market education from mature-market cross-sell
recommendations.summary: Split CRM journeys by verified product availability and audience stage.
recommendations.rationale: The working personas suggest different jobs, but client CRM and consent data are required before activation.

recommendations.title: Review affiliate state and offer copy
recommendations.summary: One demonstration placement lacks a current state/product receipt and responsible-gambling copy check.
recommendations.rationale: Hold the placement until ownership, destination and policy receipts are complete.

recommendations.title: Refresh store-page creative by product
recommendations.summary: Test a product-specific screenshot sequence while retaining the existing store listing as control.
recommendations.rationale: A controlled product-page test is appropriate once store analytics replace the synthetic performance layer.

recommendations.title: Refresh creator briefs around verified product moments
recommendations.summary: Issue a new brief with state, age, offer and responsible-gambling guardrails embedded.
recommendations.rationale: Creator work needs a human content and compliance workflow rather than a direct platform write.

recommendations.title: Realign the next TV flight around measured windows
recommendations.summary: Review weight across peak sports windows before changing the annual working-media envelope.
recommendations.rationale: The current TV layer is inferred/modelled and needs agency flowcharts and delivery evidence before a flight-level action.
recommendations.planning_prompt: Review the Linear TV flight shape against the next key sports windows. Do not change the annual working-media envelope; show the evidence needed from agency flowcharts and delivery before any reallocation.

recommendations.title: Refresh audio copy for state and product clarity
recommendations.summary: Create short variants with explicit state/product eligibility and responsible-gambling language.
recommendations.rationale: The recommendation is a briefing workflow until publisher and delivery evidence are connected.

recommendations.title: Protect responsible-gambling messaging share
recommendations.summary: The RG line must remain visible when creative or channel plans are refreshed.
recommendations.rationale: This is a governance control, not a budget available for reallocation.

recommendations.title: Realign investment around the next demand window
recommendations.summary: Use Planning OS to compare a protected-brand base with a measured response reallocation.
recommendations.rationale: A strategic shift must show channel trade-offs, state/product controls, measurement design and the unchanged active plan until approval.
recommendations.impact_label: Turn signals into a governed plan option
recommendations.planning_prompt: Build a named strategic option that protects the brand base and realigns response investment around the next demand window. Keep the active plan unchanged, show channel trade-offs, state/product controls and the measurement plan.
